rubrics.justification: It correctly states that no image was provided and does not fabricate embryo morphology, but it also cannot perform the requested morphological analysis.

It integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor, endometrium, prior IVF failure, and lifestyle factors well with the assumed embryo quality, though conclusions depend on an unverified good-quality blastocyst assumption.

The reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with clear acknowledgment of the missing image and conditional probability estimate; minor weakness is reliance on an assumed good-quality blastocyst.

Recommendations such as SET in a young patient and standard luteal support are guideline-consistent, but suggesting ERA after a single failure and relatively early consideration of PGT-A/immunologic testing is somewhat less aligned with evidence-based routine practice.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET, morphology confirmation, cycle review, uterine evaluation, and lifestyle optimization, though some suggestions are broader than strictly necessary.
